## About
It gets hot in Florida in the summertime, and the humidity never helps. Ultracool Air Conditioning & Heating is based in Sunrise, and our team handles installation, preventative maintenance, service and repair on all makes and models, for homes and businesses.
Our technicians look closely at your system before recommending anything. If your unit can be fixed efficiently, we won't try to sell you a new one. We're licensed and insured, and someone is ready to take your call around the clock.
Customers have given us a 4.9 rating across 722 Google reviews. One reviewer mentioned the owner, Neil, by name, and another said Lisa is amazing at setting up appointments.

## Services
- Installation: New air conditioning and heating systems installed for homes and businesses, on all makes and models.
- AC repair: If your AC has stopped working, we'll find the root of the problem, whether it needs a little coolant or a bigger repair.
- Maintenance: Without regular maintenance, an air conditioner loses about 5% of its original efficiency each year. Routine service keeps your system running the way it should.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work on my brand of air conditioner?
A: Our technicians are qualified to service virtually all brands and models, including Trane, Carrier, Lennox, Rheem, York and Mitsubishi.

Q: What areas do you serve?
A: We're centrally located in Sunrise, which gives us easy access to Fort Lauderdale, Plantation, Weston, Coral Springs, Parkland, Boca Raton and more.

Q: Can you help me over the phone?
A: Sometimes, yes. Give us a call first. Some A/C problems can be solved over the phone at no cost to you.
